source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: First find the first partial dividend; it tells how many digits the quotient has.
stages.headlineEnglish: First find the first partial dividend; it tells how many digits the quotient has.

stages.headline: Then divide place by place, bringing down the next digit each time.
stages.headlineEnglish: Then divide place by place, bringing down the next digit each time.

stages.headline: If the number brought down is smaller than the divisor, write 0 in the quotient and bring down the next digit.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the number brought down is smaller than the divisor, write 0 in the quotient and bring down the next digit.

stages.headline: With a two-digit divisor, find each quotient digit by estimating with round numbers.
stages.headlineEnglish: With a two-digit divisor, find each quotient digit by estimating with round numbers.
